mapper.sql: p.extsh_dt IS NULL AND p.pklt_type_cd NOT IN ('ONSTR', 'VACLOT')
mapper.select:
WITH tgt AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT p.pklt_id, p.pklt_nm, p.pklt_addr, p.emd_cd, a.sgg_nm, a.emd_nm, p.pklt_cpcty, p.instl_ym, p.lat, p.lot, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(p.lot, p.lat), 4326) AS geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(p.lot, p.lat), 4326)::geography AS g FROM parking.tb_pblpklt p LEFT JOIN parking.tb_admdst a ON a.emd_cd = p.emd_cd WHERE ),
sfty AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.pklt_id) s.pklt_id, s.sfty_chck_rslt_cd, s.chck_ymd FROM parking.v_pklt_sfty_chck_latest s WHERE s.sfty_chck_rslt_cd IN ('A', 'B', 'C') AND s.chck_ymd < to_char(CAST(#{endDtExcl} AS timestamp), 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY s.pklt_id, s.chck_ymd DESC, CASE s.sfty_chck_rslt_cd WHEN 'C' THEN 3 WHEN 'B' THEN 2 WHEN 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC), cv_asgn AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.cvlcpt_id) e.cvlcpt_id, t.pklt_id FROM tgt t JOIN parking.tb_cvlcpt e ON ST_DWithin(e.geom, t.geom, CAST(#{rdsM} AS double precision) / 80000.0) AND ST_DWithin(e.geom::geography, t.g, CAST(#{rdsM} AS double precision), false) WHERE e.ocrn_dt >= #{bgngDt} AND e.ocrn_dt < #{endDtExcl} AND e.lat IS NOT NULL AND e.cvlcpt_type_cd IN ('01','02','03','04','05') ORDER BY e.cvlcpt_id, e.geom::geography <-> t.g, t.pklt_id), crd_asgn AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.crdn_id) e.crdn_id, t.pklt_id FROM tgt t JOIN parking.tb_crdn_dsctn e ON ST_DWithin(e.geom, t.geom, CAST(#{rdsM} AS double precision) / 80000.0) AND ST_DWithin(e.geom::geography, t.g, CAST(#{rdsM} AS double precision), false) WHERE e.crdn_dt >= #{bgngDt} AND e.crdn_dt < #{endDtExcl} AND e.lat IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.crdn_id, e.geom::geography <-> t.g, t.pklt_id), utz AS ( SELECT u.pklt_id, AVG(u.day_avg_trnvr_rt) AS day_avg_trnvr_rt, COUNT(u.day_avg_trnvr_rt) AS utztn_mm_cnt FROM parking.v_pklt_utztn_pttn_latest u WHERE u.tot_ym BETWEEN #{bgngYm} AND #{endYm} GROUP BY u.pklt_id), acd AS ( SELECT h.pklt_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM parking.tb_pklt_acdnt_hstry h WHERE h.acdnt_dt >= #{bgngDt} AND h.acdnt_dt < #{endDtExcl} GROUP BY h.pklt_id) SELECT t.pklt_id, t.pklt_nm, t.pklt_addr, t.sgg_nm, t.emd_cd, t.emd_nm, t.pklt_cpcty, t.instl_ym, t.lat, t.lot, s.sfty_chck_rslt_cd, s.chck_ymd AS sfty_chck_ymd, COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS cvlcpt_cnt, z.day_avg_trnvr_rt, COALESCE(z.utztn_mm_cnt, 0)::int AS utztn_mm_cnt, COALESCE(d.cnt, 0) AS crdn_cnt, COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) AS acdnt_cnt FROM tgt t LEFT JOIN sfty s ON s.pklt_id = t.pklt_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT pklt_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM cv_asgn GROUP BY pklt_id) c ON c.pklt_id = t.pklt_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT pklt_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM crd_asgn GROUP BY pklt_id) d ON d.pklt_id = t.pklt_id LEFT JOIN utz z ON z.pklt_id = t.pklt_id LEFT JOIN acd a ON a.pklt_id = t.pklt_id ORDER BY t.pklt_id

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parking.tb_pklt_acdnt_hstry) THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parking.tb_pklt_acdnt_hstry h WHERE h.acdnt_dt >= #{bgngDt} AND h.acdnt_dt < #{endDtExcl}) END AS acdnt_cnt

SELECT (SELECT to_char(max(e.ocrn_dt), 'YYYYMMDD') FROM parking.tb_cvlcpt e WHERE e.ocrn_dt < #{endDtExcl} AND e.lat IS NOT NULL AND e.cvlcpt_type_cd IN ('01','02','03','04','05')) AS cvlcpt_last_ymd, (SELECT max(u.tot_ym) FROM parking.v_pklt_utztn_pttn_latest u JOIN parking.tb_pblpklt p ON p.pklt_id = u.pklt_id WHERE u.tot_ym <= #{endYm} AND u.day_avg_trnvr_rt IS NOT NULL AND ) AS utztn_last_ym, (SELECT max(s.chck_ymd) FROM parking.v_pklt_sfty_chck_latest s JOIN parking.tb_pblpklt p ON p.pklt_id = s.pklt_id WHERE s.sfty_chck_rslt_cd IN ('A', 'B', 'C') AND s.chck_ymd < to_char(CAST(#{endDtExcl} AS timestamp), 'YYYYMMDD') AND ) AS sfty_chck_last_ymd, (SELECT to_char(max(h.acdnt_dt), 'YYYYMMDD') FROM parking.tb_pklt_acdnt_hstry h JOIN parking.tb_pblpklt p ON p.pklt_id = h.pklt_id WHERE h.acdnt_dt < #{endDtExcl} AND ) AS acdnt_last_ymd
